src: hollow 3x3 foreground symbols collapsed to one coarse-grid pixel each; the full-edge blue marker selects the path direction
path: straight along each coarse row or column in clockwise border direction from the marker edge: top->right, right->down, bottom->left, left->up; stop when packed against the boundary or previous pixel
trajectory: stably compact all non-background coarse pixels in each parallel line, preserving their order
transform: discard the blue marker and fully empty coarse rows or columns; replace each hollow 3x3 symbol by its color
grid_shape: occupied coarse lattice after empty rows or columns are dropped
